title: Knock down two AprilTags without hitting the barrels (VEX AIM, 18 in field)
description: As two-tag, but a barrel stands next to each sign. 1 point per sign knocked down by the ball; the run fails (0 points) if the ball hits a barrel before bouncing off a wall, or the robot runs into a barrel while carrying the ball. Arena: the 18 x 18 in (0.457 m) VEX AIM field, 4 tiles. Layout 'photo' reproduces a team's start photo. MotionBench-defined, not an official VEX game.
